items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998

ctx.x: Simplicity, and the way it falls you see, no matter how the melody goes, but in terms of dealing with the progression, you know, fundamentally, it’s symmetrical. Perfectly symmetrical. There’s no chord that jerks you around and on a wrong beat.
Yeah. It just leads you right into the next thing.
